newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 29.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Tuesday:
* IMC Global agreed to buy Freeport McMoran Inc for about $750 million.
* Lincoln National said it was buying most of Cigna's individual life insurance business.
* The FCC chairman said he would support British Telecommunications's planned acquisition of MCI .
* National Westminster reportedly hired Lazard Brothers to advise it after two failed merger attempts.
* Gulf Canada Resources agreed to buy Stampeder Exploration for stock worth $532 million.
* Westinghouse reported an unexpected profit of $1 million before gains or charges.
* Treasury securities prices rose on optimism that a report on unemployment costs today would show that they remained subdued in the second quarter.
* News Corp 's plan to buy Heritage Media has run into possible antitrust problems.
* Procter & Gamble is suing Amway and 11 of its distributors, accusing them of making disparaging remarks about Procter products.
* The fast-growing countries of South and Southeast Asia have been shaken this summer by a speculative assault that has sent their currencies tumbling.
* Donna Karan said she would step down as CEO of Donna Karan International Inc to concentrate on her role as chief designer.

* Consolidation of the chip industry accelerated Monday with the announcement of two multimillion-dollar mergers, as National Semiconductor agreed to buy Cyrix and Intel agreed to buy Chips and Technologies.
* In the 1990s conglomerates have slimmed down to focus on a few areas of expertise.
